setup: The owner's Octatrack MKII, OS 1.40C, RAM-booted on development twin ed5474c6 of Modwerk base 0.8.3 (main 80ea1e584; imageSha256 is that twin's MAIN image). The module ran as a RAM trial of the package named here, the shipped USB package built from the source revision named here, the build the test procedure ran.
